tagline: FB Financial Corporation is a financial holding company headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, operating through FirstBank and providing comprehensive commercial and consumer banking services.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income is the largest contributor to the company's net income, and net interest margin reflects its fundamental ability to manage interest rate spreads on its assets and liabilities, influenced by Federal Reserve policy.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest and fees earned on interest-bearing assets and interest charges on interest-bearing liabilities.
kpis.description: Indicates the profitability of core banking operations, influenced by market interest rates and Federal Reserve policy.
kpis.signal: Improvement in core profitability through better interest rate management.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of all assets held by the company.
kpis.description: Represents the overall size of the enterprise and its investment capacity.
kpis.signal: Significant asset growth following the Southern States Bancshares acquisition.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.explanation: Total amount of deposits held by customers at the bank.
kpis.description: Primary funding source for the bank's lending activities.
kpis.signal: Strong deposit increase, indicating customer confidence and growth.

kpis.name: Loans Held for Investment
kpis.explanation: Loans originated by the bank that are held to maturity.
kpis.description: Primary assets generating interest income for the bank.
kpis.signal: Substantial growth in loan portfolio, driving interest revenue.

kpis.name: Provisions for Credit Losses
kpis.explanation: Amount set aside to cover potential loan losses.
kpis.description: Key indicator of credit risk and loan portfolio quality, including provisions on HFI loans and unfunded commitments.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in provisions related to Southern States acquisition and economic conditions.

kpis.name: Nonperforming Loans Ratio
kpis.explanation: Percentage of loans no longer generating interest income or not conforming to payment terms.
kpis.description: Measures the proportion of defaulted or nonperforming loans in the bank's portfolio.
kpis.signal: Slight deterioration in loan portfolio quality, rising from 0.87% to 0.97%.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of non-interest expenses to total revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the bank's operational efficiency in managing costs relative to revenue.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in operational efficiency, potentially due to post-acquisition integration of Southern States.

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Net income generated per unit of assets.
kpis.description: Measures the bank's ability to generate profits from its assets.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in profitability, impacted by asset growth and increased provisions.

kpis.name: Merger with Southern States Bancshares
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Southern States Bancshares, Inc. completed on July 1, 2025 to strengthen presence in existing markets and expand into Alabama and Georgia.
kpis.description: This strategic merger marked a significant step in the company's growth trajectory, based on a stock exchange ratio of 0.80 shares.
kpis.signal: Major transaction that significantly increased asset size (2.83B acquired) and deposits (2.47B assumed).

kpis.name: Goodwill from Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Goodwill recorded following the acquisition of Southern States Bancshares, reflecting the acquisition premium paid.
kpis.description: Goodwill represents the difference between acquisition cost and the fair value of identifiable net assets acquired.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the premium paid for the acquisition, impacting the balance sheet and subject to future impairment risk.

kpis.name: Dividends Declared by Company
kpis.explanation: Total amount of dividends declared by FB Financial Corporation to shareholders.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's dividend policy and commitment to shareholder capital returns.
kpis.signal: Increase in dividends per share from 0.68 to 0.76, signaling confidence in future performance.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Revenues
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly addressed in Item 7 MD&A under 'Key factors affecting our business: Interest rates'. The MD&A emphasizes that 'Volatile interest rates could have significant adverse effects on the earnings, financial condition and results of operations'. Net interest income is the largest contributor to net income (516.1M in 2025). The sensitivity of assets and liabilities to interest rate shocks amplifies this risk, particularly given a position of interest-sensitive assets (dominant HFI loans). Interest rates declined throughout 2025.

risks.title: Critical Estimates on Credit Losses (ACL)
risks.score_rationale: Provisions for credit losses increased drastically from 12.0M (2024) to 43.3M (2025), up 260.6% YoY. The MD&A indicates the increase is attributable to an initial provision of 28.4M for HFI loans acquired from Southern States and normal portfolio changes. Nonperforming loans increased from 0.87% to 0.97%. Critical ACL estimates are sensitive to economic assumptions and market developments. Economic uncertainty regarding coverage of potential defaults justifies maximum severity.

risks.title: Goodwill Valuation and Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The merger with Southern States generated 107.8M in goodwill recorded as of June 30, 2025. Although no impairment was recorded in 2025, goodwill is sensitive to changes in discount rates, future growth assumptions, and market conditions. Post-acquisition performance deterioration, rising rates, or economic contraction could trigger a material impairment charge affecting results and equity.

risks.title: Net Interest Margin Compression Risk
risks.score_rationale: Although NIM improved to 3.81% (2025) vs 3.51% (2024), the MD&A highlights 'increased competitive pressures on deposit rates' and notes that 'Continued deposit pricing pressure may continue to affect our financial results'. Interest rates declined in 2025. Continued rate declines or intensified deposit competition could compress NIM, the primary revenue driver.

risks.title: Regulatory Capital Ratio Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to capital requirements from the Federal Reserve and TDFI. The Southern States acquisition increased assets by 23.9% (to 16.3B). Credit losses and increased provisions reduce equity. Although the company reports adequate capital ratios, future impairment charges, operating losses, or regulatory changes could affect compliance.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not disclosed significant information concerning artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filing.
